◆ computeChildMortonIndices()

std::array< size_t, 8 > Utils::computeChildMortonIndices ( size_t  i)

Compute the Morton indices of the 8 child nodes of a parent node.

Given a parent node at pyramid level l, this function returns the Morton (Z-order) indices of its 8 children at level l + 1, ordered according to the Morton traversal used by the encoder and decoder.

The returned order matches the processing order assumed by the encoding pseudocode and is essential for consuming the operation stream correctly.

Parameters
iMorton (Z-order) index of the parent node at level l.
Returns
std::array<size_t, 8> Morton indices of the 8 child nodes in Z-order.
